name: Pre-Session Ignition
desc: Prime the cognitive state before externalizing. Shift from reactive to generative mode.
steps: Set phone to silent. Remove distractions.
State out loud: I am capturing everything. Nothing is too small.

name: Post-Session Integration
desc: Extract the 3 highest-signal seeds. Tag deltas. Flag codex candidates.
steps: Scan DELTA tab for evolution patterns.
If any node feels like a law or principle — copy to CODEX.
Write one sentence: what shifted this session?

name: Morning Externalization Burst
desc: Capture the hypnagogic residue — the half-awake insights that evaporate by noon.
steps: Within 5 minutes of waking, open Voice Lattice.
Record for 3 minutes without editing. Dump everything.
Flag any image, feeling, or fragment as SEED.
Do NOT review immediately — let it settle.
